name: Palo Alto PAN-OS
description: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS firewalls. Packet capture, policy tests, sessions, VPN, identity, counters, and HA.
notes: Commands are entered from the PAN-OS operational CLI.
Packet-diag captures write a pcap on the firewall; export it with scp or the web UI.
Do not leave IKE debugging enabled after the test.

workflows.title: Packet capture — host to host
workflows.summary: Filter a dataplane capture to one host pair, write a pcap, and stop cleanly.
steps: debug dataplane packet-diag set filter match source {src} destination {dst}
debug dataplane packet-diag set filter on
debug dataplane packet-diag set capture stage firewall file TSTCAP.pcap
debug dataplane packet-diag set capture on

steps.instruction: Generate the traffic, then inspect the settings and stop the capture.

cleanup: debug dataplane packet-diag set capture off
debug dataplane packet-diag set filter off
notes: Export the pcap from the firewall with scp or the web UI.
Remember to turn the filter off; otherwise later captures inherit it.

workflows.title: Packet capture — application port
workflows.summary: Capture a single source/destination/port flow and save it.
steps: debug dataplane packet-diag set filter match source {src} destination {dst} destination-port {port}
debug dataplane packet-diag set filter on
debug dataplane packet-diag set capture stage firewall file TSTCAP.pcap
debug dataplane packet-diag set capture on

steps.instruction: Reproduce the flow, then stop the capture.

cleanup: debug dataplane packet-diag set capture off
debug dataplane packet-diag set filter off

workflows.title: Session lookup
workflows.summary: Find sessions for a source or destination and inspect session metadata.
steps: show session all filter source {src} destination {dst}

workflows.title: Policy, NAT, and route tests
workflows.summary: Ask PAN-OS which security policy, NAT rule, and route will handle a flow.
steps: test security-policy-match from {src_zone} to {dst_zone} source {src} destination {dst} destination-port {port} protocol {proto}
test nat-policy-match from {src_zone} to {dst_zone} source {src} destination {dst} destination-port {port} protocol {proto}
test routing fib-lookup virtual-router default ip {dst}

workflows.title: Connectivity and route check
workflows.summary: Ping, trace, route, ARP, and interface checks for a target.

workflows.title: VPN IKE and IPsec status
workflows.summary: Inspect IKE gateways, IPsec tunnels, and VPN flow state.

workflows.title: IKE debug
workflows.summary: Enable global IKE debug output for a failing tunnel and disable it immediately after.

steps.instruction: Bring up the tunnel or send traffic, then inspect the system log and IKE output.

notes: Leaving IKE debug on can fill logs and consume CPU. Disable it immediately after the test.

workflows.title: User-ID and IP mapping
workflows.summary: Find the user mapped to an IP and list known groups.
notes: If the mapping is missing, check the User-ID agent, GlobalProtect, or the authentication profile.

workflows.title: Drops and global counters
workflows.summary: Find drop counters and resource pressure on the dataplane.
steps: show counter global filter delta yes
